meta.name: grill-with-docs
meta.description: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design, which also creates docs (ADR's and glossary) as we go.

howto.what: 运行一个 /grilling 会话，使用 /domain-modeling 技能，在审查计划或设计的同时创建架构决策记录（ADR）和术语表。
howto.when: 当用户发起 /grilling 命令或要求对计划/设计进行严格审查时。

say.text: 开始一个 grilling 会话，帮我审查我的设计方案。
say.note: Claude 会启动严格审查并记录文档。

say.text: 使用 domain-modeling 技能对当前计划进行深度分析。
运行 /grilling，并记录关键决策和术语。
say.note: 会话会生成 ADR 和术语表。

howto.what_en: Runs a /grilling session using the /domain-modeling skill, creating ADRs and glossary while sharpening a plan or design.
howto.when_en: When the user invokes the /grilling command or requests a rigorous review of a plan/design.

say_en.text: Start a grilling session to review my design plan.
say_en.note: Claude will begin a strict interview and generate docs.

say_en.text: Use domain-modeling skill for deep analysis of my plan.
say_en.note: It leverages domain-modeling and creates ADRs.

say_en.text: Run /grilling and document key decisions and terms.
